title: Let wandering end where the Guru leads
summary: The deeper union is known only through the Guru. Do not let the search outrun shelter.
takeaway: Do not let the search outrun shelter.
lifeApplication: When the hunger for one more method or explanation starts up, stop the roam before it gains speed. Stay where the Guru has already made a path.

source.shortMeaning: The deeper union is known only through the Guru.
source.lifeApplication: When wandering resumes, return to the place where the Guru meets you.

evidence.coreClaim: The deeper union is known only through the Guru.
evidence.turn: Roaming ends when the Guru reveals the deeper union.
evidence.practicalImplication: When the hunger for one more method or explanation starts up, stop the roam before it gains speed. Stay where the Guru has already made a path.
